blocks.question: CAGR from bar graph. 2018=200, 2021=343 (3-year gap).

steps.explanation:
Ratio = 343/200 = 1.715. Cube root ≈ 1.197 → CAGR ≈ 19.7%.
*Pattern: recognize perfect-cube ratios (343=7³) to shortcut the root.*
